purpose: Canonical runtime manifest (ADR-041). All machine-specific paths, ports and profiles live here so the Rust client, Python launcher and PowerShell share one source of truth. Copy to runtime.manifest.local.json and edit for another machine; the default tracks this dev machine.

local_dev_override.note: Explicit dev/CI mode only (no schedule, no day/night split: one canonical brain, honest degradation when the relay is down). The local Hikari brain is a staging surrogate for autonomous test runs where the owner's relay is not up; it is never a silent substitute.
